designEffectFromData.source: docs/generating.md, "What the analysis reports": "the design effect measured from the within-cell conversation correlation"; docs/estate.md, "Not built yet": "the design effect from the measured correlation of the variance pilot"
designEffectFromData.use: the pilot and the estate plan compute a design effect from data

iccOneWay.source: docs/generating.md, "What the analysis reports": "The intraclass correlation per level"; docs/concepts/statistics.md, "Before a campaign": "pass the rho that icc measures" to mde
iccOneWay.use: the rho the pilot and mde read, for unbalanced conversations

kishWeightDesignEffect.source: docs/reference/cli.md, driftbench space coverage: "weighted 34.0% of the declared user mix, effective sample size 6.3 of 7 specs"
kishWeightDesignEffect.use: the weighted coverage line reports the effective sample size of unequal weights

clusteredMeanInterval.source: docs/concepts/statistics.md, opening: "One conversation, or one task, is one cluster" and "reports every rate with an interval"; docs/generating.md: "Pass rate 15.9% (13.3% to 19.0%, Wilson on 638.6 effective runs)"; docs/validators.md section 7: clustered truth
clusteredMeanInterval.use: an interval on a rate of clustered runs, without resampling

oneWayAnova.source: docs/generating.md, "What the analysis reports": "the cell's wording F test holds at a false discovery rate of 0.05"
oneWayAnova.use: the wording F test of the pilot is a one-way ANOVA over wordings
